Title: Ayaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Pallavi - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sanjay - 46 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Siya - 8 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Ayaan stands on the road. Pallavi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Ayaan sits in the back seat.]

Ayaan: "This is amazing!"

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Ayaan in the back.]

Sanjay (surprised): "Good job, Ayaan!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan slips and falls.]

Pallavi: "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan trips over a stone.]

Pallavi: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan hurts his knee.]

Pallavi: "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan helps Mother get up.]

Pallavi: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan sneezes loudly.]

Ayaan: "Dad, look at this."

[Ayaan coughs.]

Ayaan (gently): "Yes, all right."

Scene 3: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Pallavi stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Ayaan: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Pallavi (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Ayaan: "One more time!"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Ayaan: "What a day to remember!"
